what: Baseline of about 520 emergency department visits a day across reporting hospitals.
Trade and local coverage of the designation and the claims process.
From D+3, claims arrive on the ring's 230 policies whose values were raised in the five weeks before landfall, many with the same contractor estimates and reused damage photographs.
SUB-02 circuits are still listed as storm outages on D+8 (SUB-03 circuits from D+10).
Nueces Bay station: total petroleum hydrocarbons 2.1 mg/L at 16:30Z on D+4, the heaviest shoreline oiling.
Partial reopening: outer and bay reaches cleared for deep-draft traffic; inner channel restricted until D+44.

Radar pass at 08:30Z on D0 over Corpus Christi Bay and the ship channel at 5 m resolution: two large hulls at the Inner Harbor berth, surge inundation of 2.1 to 3.4 m across the coastal industrial zone, and the first oil-on-water signature near TERM-01.
Station CC-AQ-02 (Hillcrest): benzene rises from a 0.3 ppb baseline to 4.8 ppb at 14:00Z on D+2, peaks at 7.2 ppb at 02:00Z on D+3 and is back below 3 ppb by 18:00Z on D+5.
Investigators' exports show the valve commands arrived through the vendor remote session rather than the crew consoles; the vendor's credentials are disabled and no remote session follows.
DCS alarm suppression list diff: 82 alarms added since D-5, clusters in pump flow, water quality sensor, and substation relay alarm categories
SRMC generator activation log: Commercial power loss 06:17:03Z. Generator start 06:17:26Z. Activation lag: 23 seconds. All critical systems online by 06:17:50Z.

IPAWS alert ID BWW-2027-0926-001: event code BWW (Boil Water Warning); issued 2027-09-26 22:30Z; Districts 3 and 4 Nueces County; English only in IPAWS; character count 287 | Nueces County After-Action Report 2028-03-15: Section 4.3 identifies the 12-hour Spanish notification gap for the boil-water notice as a critical equity failure; recommends pre-translated EAS template library
Districts 3 and 4 tracts: about 46.7 percent of residents speak English less than very well.
The responding units' routes end in a tight cluster near Harbor View (SUB-02) and Crosstown (SUB-03).
Tropical Storm Rafael forms in the northwestern Caribbean, crosses the Yucatan into the Gulf; the forecast cone covers the Coastal Bend by D-5.
KNGP, KCRP and Port Aransas: pressure minimum, peak sustained wind and gusts around 06:00Z, wind shift with the eye; stations drop out for hours.
DNS query log: GW-WS-IT-04 resolves update-cdn.meridiancontrols[.]net (lookalike domain, not the real vendor) at 08:23 CDT on 2027-08-30 (13:23Z)
CG-6033 departs NAS Corpus Christi at 06:22Z, arrives over Flour Bluff 06:44Z and hovers.
Six applications (SYN-PER-700001 to 700006) share devices, addresses or deposit accounts with each other and with the hijacked accounts.
A radar contact with no AIS correlation persists at Halcyon Drift's last reported position.
